finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs, not just noise:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `retryCount`. Threw `TypeError` on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treated an unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid. New config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it threw. Now `undefined` maps to `false`.

Rest of the warnings are deprecation noise from the dep bump, harmless.

Next: rerun your normal build to confirm on your machine too.
